description: This file defines a static enum GatewayLaunchAgentManager that manages macOS launch agents related to the OpenClaw application. It provides functions for enabling/disabling, checking status, and interacting with launch agent configurations, including running daemon commands and parsing their output.

classes.name: CommandResult
classes.description: Encapsulates the outcome of a daemon command, including success status, payload data, and message.

classes.name: ParsedDaemonJson
classes.description: Represents parsed JSON data extracted from daemon command responses, including raw text and JSON object.

methods.name: isLaunchAgentWriteDisabled
methods.description: Checks if the launch agent write disable marker file exists, indicating write is disabled.

methods.name: setLaunchAgentWriteDisabled
methods.description: Creates or removes the disable marker file based on the 'disabled' parameter, returning error descriptions if any.

methods.name: isLoaded
methods.description: Asynchronously determines if the daemon is loaded by reading daemon status.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Enables or disables the launch agent based on parameters, involving running daemon commands.

methods.name: kickstart
methods.description: Restarts the daemon by running a restart command.

methods.name: launchdConfigSnapshot
methods.description: Retrieves a snapshot of the launch agent plist configuration.

methods.name: launchdGatewayLogPath
methods.description: Determines the path to the gateway log, prioritizing stdout/stderr paths from the config snapshot.

methods.name: readDaemonLoaded
methods.description: Parses daemon status JSON to determine if it is loaded.

methods.name: runDaemonCommand
methods.description: Runs a daemon command with the specified arguments and handles success/failure.

methods.name: runDaemonCommandResult
methods.description: Executes the daemon command, parses output JSON, and returns success status with payload and messages.

methods.name: withJsonFlag
methods.description: Ensures '--json' flag is present in command arguments.

methods.name: parseDaemonJson
methods.description: Parses raw string output into structured JSON data.

methods.name: summarize
methods.description: Summarizes log text by extracting the last line.
